title: Unimaginable grief: 8 Pune students on school picnic drown at Diveagar beach
content: A picnic at Diveagar beach turned tragic when eight students from Pune drowned after being swept away. They misjudged the sea's depth and current strength, leading to their distress. Local authorities and rescue teams responded promptly to recover all eight bodies. Maharashtra ministers expressed their condolences and sought details regarding the incident. Legal and administrative procedures are currently being conducted at the site of the tragedy.

title: 'He was smiling & laughing': India's envoy to UAE meets flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar
content: Indian ambassador Deepak Mittal visited Captain Smit Machchhar at the hospital following the stabbing incident. Captain Machchhar was attacked by his co-pilot while flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv. After the initial treatment in Saudi Arabia, he was airlifted to Abu Dhabi for further medical care. Passengers and two other pilots helped to restrain the attacker and safely landed the flight.

title: 'Kill me, kill me': Netanyahu reveals words of 'indoctrinated' flydubai co-pilot
content: In a troubling turn of events, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has leveled serious accusations against the co-pilot of a flydubai flight, suspecting him of undergoing Islamist radical indoctrination. Investigative efforts are underway, following a situation where the critically injured pilot managed to alert authorities and enable passengers, alongside off-duty pilots, to subdue the attacker, resulting in an emergency landing.

title: What is Apple's next big product: Here's everything you need to know
content: Apple's next big launch of 2026 isn't an iPhone. According to Bloomberg, Apple will launch its first smart home display, code-named J490 and dubbed the HomePad, on October 13. The 6-inch hub features an iMac G4-inspired design, face and voice recognition for household members, and Siri AI. Apple will also launch a HomePod mini with a faster chip and fresh colours, alongside an upgraded Apple TV 4K.

title: Gandhi Jayanti 2026: Best wishes, quotes & WhatsApp status
content: October 2 serves as a poignant reminder of Gandhi Jayanti, honoring Mahatma Gandhi's enduring legacy of truth and non-violence. This significant day encourages individuals to reflect on the applicability of these ideals in current society. In various communities, people commemorate Gandhi by participating in charitable activities and dialogues about his teachings, facilitating a richer understanding of ethical values in our everyday lives.

title: Harekala Hajabba turned one painful moment into a mission to build a village school
content: Harekala Hajabba, despite facing a significant language barrier, pursued a transformative vision for his community through education. Lacking formal schooling, he understood how education could help alleviate poverty. He began his journey by saving profits from orange sales, ultimately earning national acclaim as a recipient of the Padma Shri award. His story serves as a powerful testament to how individual determination can uplift an entire community.

title: Drama! India’s Asian Games medal upgraded: Finished fourth, now bronze
content: Harshita Tomar and Shital Verma from India initially placed fourth in the women's skiff sailing event. They received a bronze medal after the Chinese pair was disqualified for an undisclosed reason. The competition took place at the Kaiyoh Yacht Harbor in Aichi, Japan. Japan finished first with 14 net points, followed by Hong Kong with 18 points. India's final tally allowed them to secure the bronze, making a historic achievement.

title: Gadkari backs IIT tech; waste plastic used in bitumen for NH-44 for first time
content: A pilot test section was laid recently along the main carriageway of NH-44 in Jhansi. Officials involved in the pilot said the technology could lower the consumption of conventional bitumen by around 4%, reducing demand for a material that India largely imports to meet its domestic needs.

title: 'Don't want BJP to come': AIMIM leaves door open for alliance ahead of 2027 UP polls
content: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi stated his party is willing to form alliances in Uttar Pradesh. This decision comes ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections scheduled for early next year. Owaisi emphasized the importance of preventing the BJP from securing a third consecutive term. He also criticized the implementation of the Uniform Civil Code in various states as discriminatory.

title: Thomas Stone paid $400 for 442-acre Maryland estate; it became historic site
content: Originally founded by John Barefoot and expanded by Daniel Jenifer, Haberdeventure estate is steeped in history. Thomas Stone bought the estate in 1770, preserving it within his family for 166 years. A significant fire in 1977 led to protective actions and, in 1978, it became the Thomas Stone National Historic Site. Following restorations completed in 1997, it now spans 328 acres, serving as a historical hub for inquisitive visitors.

title: 12 paintings hidden for 50 years head to auction valued near $450 million
content: An exceptional auction is on the horizon for November 18, 2026, showcasing a collection of twelve remarkable impressionist and post-impressionist pieces, valued at almost $500 million. Highlighted artworks include Vincent van Gogh’s 'Châtaigniers en fleurs' and Paul Cézanne’s 'Arlequin,' which have not been publicly available for decades. Sotheby's is optimistic about attracting a global congregation of elite buyers, promising a historic event in the world of art sales.

title: Odisha man left job to build seed bank saving India’s traditional rice varieties
content: Debal Deb established Vrihi in 1997 to conserve traditional rice varieties through seed exchange among farmers. The seed bank contains 1,480 rice landraces collected from various locations and contributed to national conservation efforts. By June 2026, over 8,000 farmers in 13 states received rice seeds through Vrihi's programs. The organization also assists in establishing community seed banks across India.

title: Watch: Hero flydubai pilot treated shortly after landing; airlifted to Abu Dhabi
content: An alarming incident unfolded on a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv when co-pilot attacked pilot Smit Machchhar, resulting in a mid-air emergency landing. Machchhar’s quick thinking enabled him to unlock the cockpit door, facilitating crew intervention. Passengers stepped in heroically to restrain the co-pilot. Subsequently, Machchhar was airlifted to a medical facility in Dubai as authorities in Saudi Arabia and the UAE begin investigations into this disturbing incident.

title: How Logan Paul built a $150 million fortune through WWE, Prime and boxing
content: Logan Paul has built an estimated $150 million fortune by marrying digital media with sports entertainment and consumer businesses. PRIME Hydration, WWE earnings, boxing appearances, YouTube, podcasting, sponsorships, collectibles and venture investments are all part of his financial portfolio. Paul has leveraged his personal brand into various commercial sources of income ranging from viral internet fame to mainstream entertainment.

title: Centre 'examining' flydubai incident, may tweak safety norms; full-body scanners being tested
content: India's aviation security authority is currently conducting trials of full-body scanners at Bengaluru and Cochin airports to collect critical data. These scanners are being adapted to reflect common Indian customs regarding jewelry and attire. Results from these trials will inform whether they are implemented across eight specified airports. Furthermore, Indian officials are assessing a recent incident involving a Flydubai pilot injury, with potential security advisories to follow internal consultations.

title: North Carolina family protects 298 acres 214 years after buying land in 1811
content: In a remarkable effort to maintain their agricultural heritage, a North Carolina family has successfully preserved 298 acres of land from development over seven generations. Acquired in 1811 by John W. Caldwell and Nancy Hartfield, this property operates as a working forest. The enacted conservation easement guarantees that this land will remain untouched by housing or commercial ventures, earning recognition from conservation groups for their sustainable management practices.

title: Roger Daltrey opened brewery on 600-acre Sussex farm after creating trout lakes
content: Founded in 2020 by Roger Daltrey and his family, Lakedown Brewing Co. is a charming microbrewery based in East Sussex. Dedicated to crafting easy-drinking beers from high-quality ingredients, they also oversee the Lakedown Trout Fishery, creating a picturesque setting for visitors. Committed to the local community, the brewery actively supports youth music training initiatives, with their beers available in many independent pubs around Sussex.

title: Indian IT sector layoffs: Which jobs are facing pressure & which skills are in demand?
content: AI is not just making some jobs in the Indian IT sector obsolete, it is also forcing firms to adapt their business models as the demand for their traditional services faces disruption. In FY27, hiring is expected to remain subdued, while attrition is increasingly being backfilled selectively rather than one-for-one.

title: 8 Pune students on school picnic drown at Diveagar beach; bodies recovered
content: Eight students from Pune tragically drowned at Diveagar beach in Maharashtra during a school picnic. Authorities have confirmed that all eight bodies were recovered following the incident. The local police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the drowning. Further details regarding the victims and the details of their outing are still awaited. This incident highlights the need for increased safety measures at popular tourist locations.

title: Kylian Mbappé teams up with Hublot for limited-edition luxury watch
content: In April 2026, Hublot celebrated the launch of the limited edition Big Bang Reloaded Kylian Mbappé watch at Watches & Wonders. This exquisite timepiece combines polished white ceramic with 18K King Gold, featuring Mbappé's inspiring mantra, 'Trust Yourself,' beautifully engraved on the bezel. With only 200 numbered pieces available, each watch comes with two interchangeable straps.

title: Jason Blake gets emotional as son Jackson wins Stanley Cup with Carolina
content: Jason Blake, a former NHL forward, spent 13 seasons and 871 regular-season games chasing hockey’s biggest prize without ever getting past the second round of the Stanley Cup Playoffs. But his son Jackson Blake had the opposite outcome in 2026 with the Carolina Hurricanes, helping them defeat the Vegas Golden Knights in six games while providing a tearful championship moment for his family.

title: India win sailing, wrestling silver; cricket and hockey teams enter gold medal matches
content: India secured silver medals in sailing and Greco-Roman wrestling after a successful day at the Asian Games. The men's T20 cricket team posted a solid score and eliminated Sri Lanka to reach the finals. Meanwhile, the men's hockey team narrowly defeated Pakistan with a last-minute goal by Abhishek. India's women’s golf team secured a bronze position ahead of the final round.

title: Anup Bagchi appointed HDFC bank CEO
content: HDFC Bank has confirmed the appointment of Anup Bagchi as its new managing director and CEO, effective October 27, 2026. With over three decades of banking experience, primarily at ICICI Group, Bagchi is set to replace Sashidhar Jagdishan, who served until October 26, 2026. His vision includes expanding HDFC Bank’s loan portfolio while supervising credit management. The Reserve Bank of India sanctioned his role on October 1, 2026.

title: Nepal avalanche kills 15 workers at Himlung Himal camp, one still missing
content: An avalanche struck the base camp of Himlung Himal, resulting in the deaths of at least 15 Nepali workers. The workers were preparing for an all-women climbing group that was scheduled to arrive soon. Rescuers recovered the bodies, but one worker remains missing after poor weather hampered operations. The incident has been reported as the deadliest of the autumn climbing season in Nepal.

title: Pink ball in day Tests, penalties for time-wasting: ICC announces new rules
content: The changes will apply to all international series beginning on October 1 or later, while series that are already underway will continue under the existing regulations.

title: Why children who sing during daily routines may be doing more than having fun
content: As young children engage in daily routines like dressing or eating, they often craft spontaneous songs. Such musical expressions not only showcase their creativity but also play a vital role in language development through rhythm and repetition. Parents should cherish these moments, allowing children the freedom to explore their song-making abilities without interference. Observing the themes in their melodies can reveal their interests and cognitive processes.

title: Virginia widow saved Frank Lloyd Wright home by moving it 13 miles
content: Marjorie Leighey fought to save the Pope-Leighey House from destruction due to the construction of Interstate 66. After her husband's death, she mobilized support from preservationists and the public to save her home. The house was eventually moved to the Woodlawn property, where it remains accessible to visitors today. Marjorie's efforts were instrumental in highlighting the importance of preserving modern architectural treasures.

title: California couple faced $1m fines from previous owner; settlement clears them
content: After acquiring a property in Humboldt County, Corrine and Doug Thomas stumbled upon unforeseen legal complications linked to the former owner's cannabis business. Faced with over $1 million in fines and demolition fees, the couple reached a resolution that not only annulled these penalties but also mandated changes in the county's enforcement practices. This agreement grants property owners additional time to address alleged violations, protecting them from disproportionate financial impacts.

title: 18 warships, wider global reach: Indian Navy eyes biggest-ever fleet expansion
content: India's Navy is set to expand its fleet significantly by inducting 18 warships in 2026. The Navy's focus is on enhancing its capabilities and addressing maritime security challenges amid complexities in the region. This expansion reflects advancements in India's domestic shipbuilding ecosystem and aims to strengthen India's strategic maritime role. The recent conference highlighted the need for improved monitoring systems to safeguard Indian shipping lanes.

title: Aaron Judge hosts 232 young Bronx players, donates $9,999 to Little League
content: On August 11, 2026, Aaron Judge's ALL RISE Foundation held a memorable Baseball ProCamp for 232 aspiring Bronx Little Leaguers at Fordham University. The event included participation from former Yankees player Tyler Wade. Judge took the opportunity to share insights on teamwork with the youngsters. Additionally, the foundation generously donated $9,999.

title: Roger Federer's foundation helps 300,000 South African children access education
content: Roger Federer’s foundation has made early education a major focus across Southern Africa, supporting children, teachers and communities in countries including South Africa, Lesotho, Malawi, Namibia, Zambia and Zimbabwe. In 2025, Federer revealed that its work in South Africa had provided quality preschool education to more than 300,000 children. However, significant gaps remain, with millions of children still needing stronger access to quality early learning and educational resources.

title: California men allegedly billed Medicare $3.5m through fake medical firms
content: Nouman Mustafa and Mohsin Khan have been charged with healthcare fraud for filing false claims to Medicare through fictitious businesses that lacked physical locations for medical supplies. They reportedly sourced personal data from legitimate Medicare beneficiaries via foreign contacts. To avoid detection, they frequently changed company identities, leading to arrests after a federal probe, encompassing charges of identity theft and healthcare fraud.

title: Meet Liam Desré, 14, whose dark energy alternative won €5,000 science prize
content: Liam Desre, a bright Grade 10 student hailing from Kingston, Ontario, introduced a groundbreaking cosmological model that earned him the second prize at the European Union Contest for Young Scientists in Germany. By shifting focus from dark energy to the impact of entropy on cosmic acceleration, he presents a fresh perspective that challenges existing cosmological theories.
